evidence: Carries the 'Build system' label and modifies Guix build scripts, manifests, and toolchain configurations under contrib/guix/.
rationale: Updates the Guix time-machine commit to enable newer compiler toolchains (Clang 22/23, GCC 16) and drop obsolete package workarounds. As routine release infrastructure modernization that does not fix an active release breakage or immediate security vulnerability, it provides real value but is reasonably deferrable.
